about: Boisbriand is a suburban city on Montréal’s North Shore in the Laurentides, along Autoroute 15 between Blainville and Sainte-Thérèse / Rosemère. It grew with residential neighbourhoods, big-box retail, and a former GM assembly plant site that reshaped the local economy. Parks and the Rivière des Mille Îles corridor mark the city’s edges. About 28,000 people live in Boisbriand.
